applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8 and structures within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets are included in the site plan set. Building elevation sheets with surveyed elevations and clearance dimensions from overhead conductors are required to demonstrate compliance with 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8, building projections, and structures within clearance distance of overhead electric lines
findings.comment: No section or profile exhibits are provided showing dimensions from the outer electric conductor to building edges and projections. Clearance verification exhibits are required to demonstrate compliance with UCM § 1.10.3 clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Perimeter fences along property boundaries, particularly southern boundary where overhead electric line is located
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows fences near property boundaries where overhead electric lines are located. No clearance dimensions are provided from the outside conductor to fence alignments. Dimensions are required to verify that fences maintain the minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance.

applicableAreas: Property boundary areas with existing utility poles
findings.comment: Utility poles exist on or adjacent to property boundaries. Fence post locations are not dimensioned relative to pole locations. Clearance dimensions of at least 10 feet horizontally from fence posts to poles cannot be verified from available plans.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls near overhead electric facilities, particularly pond walls and southern retaining walls
findings.comment: Wall plans are provided (Sheet 38-39) but do not include clearance section exhibits showing dimensions from outer electric conductors to wall faces. Section views with clearance dimensions are required to verify the 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance from walls to overhead electric conductors.

applicableAreas: Driveways and parking areas, particularly in southern portion of site near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Grading and landscape plans show driveway alignments and finished grades adjacent to overhead electric facilities. No vertical clearance dimensions or mid-span survey data are provided to verify the minimum 16-foot vertical clearance for driveways without truck traffic or 18-foot clearance for areas with truck traffic.

applicableAreas: Overhead electric conductor locations throughout property
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines are shown on existing conditions survey and landscape plan, but no clearance dimensions are provided anywhere on the plans. Without dimension annotations showing distances from the outside conductor (not pole centerline), compliance with code measurements cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Water utility lines in proximity to overhead distribution facilities
findings.comment: Water utility plans show water line routing, but clearance dimensions between water lines and overhead electric distribution facilities are not provided. Clearance verification dimensions are required to demonstrate compliance.

applicableAreas: Overhead electric facilities throughout property, particularly in areas where proposed site features may approach minimum clearance distances
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines are shown on site plans but no registered surveyor mid-span clearance data are provided. When vertical clearances from overhead facilities to proposed site features appear marginal or insufficient, UCM § 1.10.3 requires registered surveyor data confirming minimum clearances are maintained.

applicableAreas: Southern landscape area along overhead electric line where mitigation trees are planted; mitigation trees located approximately 5 feet from overhead electric conductor
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows three new trees (one mitigation tree labeled 'M' at approximately 5 feet from overhead electric line, one street yard tree 'SY', and one parking buffer tree 'P') with canopies crossing the overhead electric line. The tree species are not identified on the landscape plan. Trees within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors must be from the Utility Compatible Shade Trees list (ECM Appendix F, marked 'UC'). Without species identification, utility compatibility cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Property with existing utility poles and proposed site improvements including driveways and accessible paths
findings.comment: Existing survey shows utility poles on property boundaries, but down guy wire locations are not documented on any plan. Down guys typically support distribution poles and may conflict with proposed driveways or accessible paths. Absence of down guy documentation prevents verification of resolution of any conflicts.

applicableAreas: Site construction staging areas and equipment laydown zones
findings.comment: No construction staging plan or site logistics plan is provided with the site plan set. Construction staging areas, equipment operation zones, and work platforms must maintain a minimum 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines per OSHA and Texas law. A construction plan showing these areas and clearance verification is required.

applicableAreas: Building roof penetrations for service masts
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets are provided in the site plan set. Service-mast through-roof installations cannot be reviewed to verify minimum 3-foot clearance above roof (or 18-inch clearance if within 4 feet of roof edge for voltages ≤300V). Building elevation sheets with service mast details are required.
